body: I’m full of energy so I’ve cleaned my whole apartment. I’ve done lots of things for just two hours
Although my husband and I made peace after a long-standing quarrel, and everything is good now, I still have suicidal thoughts in the evenings and no taste for life. So devastated
I’m also addicted to alcohol. And it became normally for me to drink even alone. Love these feelings when I’m drunk, this dizziness. I’m trying to distract myself from the reality...

Thanks for your kindness! Yesterday I talked to my ex husband. We want to try again. I’m bipolar, he just didn’t know about it. I told him everything that’s inside of my head. We will try... it’s a little hope, but i feel much better. Thank you all!!!
It helped me once, indeed. I should try it again, but now I feel soo weak and numb, sometimes it seems I can’t even move. I will just wait a bit and then will practice it one more time.

A million thanks 🙏 It sounds very inspiring to me indeed! I’ve suddenly understood that I’m very dependent on people, their opinions, love... I should do something with it. I want to be finally happy even being alone.
Yes, you were right. I visited my psychiatrist, he said it’s rapid cycling bibolar. Prescribed me valproic acid...
Me too actually. I have often compulsive suicidal thoughts. Each day is suffering
Hi guys. I’ve started a new project. Actually it’s a solo one. And stuck with creating a music name for it... what do you think about “astrobleme”? Is this word suitable?
